title: •Kitik Keed’kak
caption: •Kitik Keed’kak (V)
game_text: During battle, may add 1 to your attrition against opponent for each opponent’s character present. May not deploy to or board starfighters or enclosed vehicles.
lore: A female insectoid Yam’rii. Very strong and easily angered. Known for stealth, but also has good technological aptitude. Meat eater. Loves eggs.
